title: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics-Uganda Progress Report July- September 2025
publisher: Bloomberg Data for Health Initiative (D4H)-Uganda/U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and CDC Foundation
why_not: States registration rates (3.6% births, 10% deaths, 22 July 2025) and a plan to digitise the birth notification form in DHIS2 for integration with MVRS, but no fact on how or at how many offices the record is made, and its events fall before the twelve-month window.
